method: AST inspection and manual observations bound to exact pinned source; candidate not executed

observations.os_error_response: error: unable to read input file

findings.detail: The CLI opens the supplied path and follows symlinks. It does not restrict reads to a workspace.
The byte limit does not bound open/read time; a FIFO or device may block. No regular-file check or timeout is present.
Successful JSON output includes the entire decoded input. Callers must prevent sensitive file inputs and unintended output disclosure.

limitations: No dynamic security testing or candidate execution
No proof of host isolation, filesystem containment, dependency integrity or absence of all vulnerabilities
Historical QA signature is provenance, not a current lease or execution authorization
